_help: Don't put your Google key here. Put it in config.local.json (copy config.local.example.json), which git ignores. Restart the server after editing.
_help_contact: Optional, also best set in config.local.json: an email or website for the User-Agent sent to weather.gov and MET Norway.
_help_sources: Turn individual weather sources on or off. Google Weather is billable after 10,000 calls a month and the three free sources already cover the trip, so it is off; set it to true to use it (the monthly caps below still apply).
_help_ttl: How long a fetched forecast is reused before it is fetched again (minutes). Forecast models update every 1–6 hours, so shorter is wasteful.
_help_google_caps: Most billable Google calls the app will make per calendar month (Pacific time), counted in cache/google_usage.json. Google gives 10,000 free per month for each; staying under that keeps the bill at $0. At a cap the app stops calling Google until the 1st (the map falls back to Google's watermarked dev map). 0 blocks that one entirely.
